name: kiny
description: Kiny — 受 Ink 启发的互动叙事 DSL 生态（engine / player / viewer / editor）。子项目各自自包含构建，本文件只做跨子项目的顺序编排，不使用 npm workspaces。

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix engine install && npm --prefix player install && npm --prefix error-report install && npm --prefix viewer install && npm --prefix editor install && npm --prefix reader install && npm --prefix shelf install
scripts.build:core: npm run build:engine && npm run build:player && npm run build:error-report
scripts.build:viewer: npm run build:core && npm --prefix viewer run build
scripts.build:editor: npm run build:core && npm --prefix editor run build
scripts.build:reader: npm run build:core && npm --prefix reader run build
scripts.build:shelf: npm run build:core && npm --prefix shelf run build
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:player && npm run test:error-report && npm run test:viewer && npm run test:editor && npm run test:reader && npm run test:shelf
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix engine run typecheck && npm --prefix player run typecheck && npm --prefix error-report run typecheck && npm --prefix viewer run typecheck && npm --prefix editor run typecheck && npm --prefix reader run typecheck && npm --prefix shelf run typecheck
scripts.dev:viewer: npm run build:core && npm --prefix viewer run dev
scripts.dev:shelf: npm run build:core && npm --prefix shelf run dev
scripts.dev:editor: npm run build:core && npm --prefix editor run tauri dev
scripts.dev:reader: npm run build:core && npm --prefix reader run tauri dev
scripts.dev:reader:android: npm run build:core && npm --prefix reader run tauri:android
scripts.tauri:build: npm run build:core && npm --prefix editor run tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:reader: npm run build:core && npm --prefix reader run tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:reader:android: npm run build:core && npm --prefix reader run tauri:android:build
